summary: Comprehensive testing of Admin Dashboard v1.0.4 with warm design theme completed. Backend APIs 100% functional with new variable format. Frontend design perfectly implemented but login integration has authentication issue.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend login fails with 'Invalid access key' error despite backend API working perfectly with same credentials

Backend: FIFO queue system working perfectly
Backend: Authentication with master key via API
Frontend: Login page warm gradient design (orange/coral gradients)
Frontend: Rounded-xl cards and shadow elements
Frontend: Shield icon and proper typography
Frontend: All design elements per requirements

success_percentage.backend: 100% - All APIs functional, version 1.0.4, new variable format working

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix frontend login integration issue. Backend API works perfectly with master key via curl, but frontend form returns 'Invalid access key' error. Check AuthContext.js, axios configuration, or potential JavaScript errors preventing proper authentication.
